title: Page 2
content_zh:
言待榆二话不说，先将好友护在身后，一脸戒备的看着男人，“不好意思，刚才是我认错人了，不是故意要恶整你，请你原谅。”是她不对，她毫不扭捏的道歉。
“你不必紧张，我只是想了解一下原因，没有什么意思。”男人笑得毫无芥蒂。
看他真的没有要追究的意思，言待榆这才松了一口气，“是啦！我一看就知道你明事理，怪就怪你长得太好，那家店里最帅的人就是你，谁不会误会啊！”她手一摊，还要他评评理。
他给了她一抹亲切的笑容，“我一点也不怪你。”
“谢谢你的宽宏大量，我和朋友还有事，不打扰你了。”话一说完，言待榆留下被错认的倒霉男人，拖着朋友就跑。
“找不到人这种小事你处理就好，你是要我临时去哪里生出一个晚班的工读生给你啊？”殷策心情恶劣的讲着手机，修长的身躯懒懒的靠向椅背，看到窗外一对男女像是在争吵似的，他不耐的看向那对男女。
啊……是上次那个溜很快的小姐，她看起来仍然是那么的有精神。
“好吧！我再想想办法……不，我今天不会去餐厅，就这样，掰。”殷策将手机放在一旁，撑着下巴，无聊的听着那对男女的谈话内容──看来这位小姐的麻烦事一堆。
“林颜强，我朋友罗曼曼已经拒绝你了，你还想怎么样？”找不到罗曼曼就到她上班的地点来堵她，是当她好欺负吗？
“我要她当面跟我说！”林颜强气急败坏道。
“上星期二不就说得很清楚了吗？她‘当面’拒绝你了。”早知道就录像存证，让他无话可说。
“那是我跟她的事，不用你多事。”
“她的事就是我的事，请你不要再纠缠她了。”言待榆双手叉腰，一副母夜叉的凶样。
“是你叫她拒绝我的吧？”他的条件这么好，所以完全不懂罗曼曼为什么会拒绝他，一定是这女人指使的！
“香肠先生，如果罗小姐对你有意思，无论我说什么都没有用，你就面对现实一点好吗？现实就是罗小姐的眼光很奇怪，她喜欢肉感的男人！”不是要故意拆好友的底，但她真的受够了。
香肠？殷策忍不住轻笑出声──这位小姐还真是有趣。
林颜强气急道：“你这女人不要乱帮我取绰号，明明就是你在那里兴风作浪，阻碍我和小曼！”
“反正我说什么，你都听不进去，我懒得和你说了。”她不理他，转身要绕过他，见他又挡住去路，抿着唇瞪他。
“你叫小曼来跟我谈。”
“我为什么要听你的？”

“你──”林颜强抓住她的手腕，“现在就带我去找小曼！”
“你放手喔！”言待榆皱眉，正与他僵持不下的同时，突然有人伸手将林颜强的手拉住，她抬头一看，当下认出是前天被她错认的倒霉鬼。
“对小姐要温柔一点，有话好好说。”殷策好声劝道。
“你少多管闲事。”林颜强口气不善道。
言待榆尴尬的对殷策笑了笑，“这我自己来处理就好。”
她已经很对不起这个倒霉鬼了，哪还有脸要他帮忙赶走瘟神，她正经的看向林颜强，“林颜强先生，罗曼曼并不适合你，除非你再胖个三十公斤，不然就不要再强求了。”她很实在的说。
“你还想骗我！”叫他再胖个三十公斤，他会当真才怪。
她苦恼的揉揉眉心，“不然这样好了，换我跟你交往好了，其实我暗恋你很久了，而且怎么看我都比较适合。”她保证不用一天，他就会哭着求她分手。
殷策挑眉看她，她看起来一点也不像喜欢这个叫什么香肠的男人。
“谁要跟你这个丑女人交往。”林颜强涨红了脸。
“丑？”是啦！她是没罗曼曼漂亮，但他有必要用到“丑”这种字眼吗？但她依然忍住气，“你可别看我这样，我的心地很善良，不然你问我旁边这位好人先生。”
好人先生？！殷策扬眉，心里只觉得可笑。
“你再不走，我就当作你其实是在暗恋我，想要跟我交往了。”她说完就要攀上林颜强的手臂。
林颜强急忙后退，“你这个神经病，谁要跟你这种女人交往！”说完恼怒的离开。
言待榆松了一口气──麻烦终于走了；她看向身旁的男人，咧嘴一笑，“刚才谢谢你了。”
“不客气。”他也不想理会，但却没办法眼睁睁的看男人欺负女人，“刚才你们说的那个罗曼曼，是之前我遇到的那一位吗？”
“对。”
“你对朋友还真是照顾。”他记得上次她会找他麻烦，也是为了替那位小姐出气。
“罗曼曼很笨，不顾着点是不行的。”林颜强的家世是很好，也有着不错的外表，但就是太少爷个性，而罗曼曼也是个需要人照顾的个性，所以两人一点也不适合。
“她很幸运有你这个朋友。”在他看来，这女人是日子过得太闲，是在自找麻烦。

她保持礼貌的微笑，心里却想着──这男人看来斯文俊雅，说话也是客气有礼，如果和罗曼曼在一起，应该会是天造地设的一对。
所谓冶疗失恋的方法就是谈一场新恋情，或许她可以试试。“谢谢你的帮忙，我请你喝个饮料。”
“不用客气。”她想搭讪吗？原来又是一个看上他的外表的女人！
“应该的。”再说她也讨厌欠人人情，“你想喝什么？乌龙茶好不好？”
“好。”他跟着她一起走进店内，坐回原本的位子，想看看她有何打算？“你在这间茶馆工作？”看她跟里面的服务生打了个招呼，像是很熟稔的朋友。
“对。”她自动的坐在他的对面，“我先自我介绍一下，我是言待榆。”拿出自己的名牌让他看了一眼，“你叫我大鱼就好，鱼是水中游的鱼。”
“我是殷策。”他看着她问道：“你这样跟我聊天，老板不会生气吗？”
“我已经下班了，我今天上的是早班。”她看了他一眼，“方便透露一下你的职业吗？”她得先做个基本身家调查，替罗曼曼鉴定一下。
“我在一间餐厅工作。”
“所以你也是服务生？”她猜测着他的工作内容。
“你觉得当服务生不好吗？”
“怎么会，又不是不事生产。”她当他是承认了──嗯～～有正当的工作很好，她摸着鼻子，“殷先生，你……”
“有话直说。”他浅浅微笑，心里想着却是该如何给她一点教训，让他一吐前天的怨气。
“你有没有女朋友？”她怕把人给吓跑，又急忙补充说明，“我没有要追你，你可以放心，我是看你的个性不错，想介绍朋友给你认识。”
“是那个叫罗曼曼的小姐吗？”他有些意外，原来她是为了朋友问的。
“对对对，就是她！你也看过，就是上次躲在我身后那个长得很娇小可爱的人，她的个性很好，人又温柔又有耐心。”
“交朋友当然好，但她愿意吗？”他开始想着推托之词。
“她当然愿意。”
“你不怕我是坏人吗？”优雅的喝着刚送上来的茶饮，清香甘甜是还不错。
“我当然不可能丢下她一人。”她手支着脸，眼睛笑得眯眯的，“改天一起吃顿饭吧！”

殷策看着她的笑脸，想拒绝却突然想起店里急需工读生，顿时改变了心意，露出迷人的笑容，“好啊！”
第1章(2)
content_en:
Without saying a word, Yan Taiyu protected her friend behind her and looked at the man warily, "I'm sorry, I just recognized the wrong person. I didn't mean to harm you. Please forgive me." It was her fault, and she apologized without hesitation.
"Don't be nervous. I just want to understand the reason. It doesn't mean anything." The man smiled without any grudge.
Seeing that he really had no intention of pursuing the matter, Yan Taiyu breathed a sigh of relief, "Yes! I can tell at a glance that you are sensible. I blame you for being so good-looking. You are the most handsome person in that store. Who wouldn't misunderstand me?" She spread her hands and asked him to comment.
He gave her a friendly smile and said, "I don't blame you at all."
"Thank you for your magnanimity. My friend and I have something to do, so I won't disturb you anymore." As soon as he finished speaking, Yan Taiyu left the unlucky man who was mistakenly identified and ran away, dragging his friend with him.
"You can handle such a small thing as finding someone. Where do you want me to temporarily give birth to a night shift work-study student for you?" Yin Ce was talking on the phone in a bad mood. His slender body leaned back lazily on the chair. He saw a man and a woman outside the window who seemed to be arguing. He looked at the man and woman impatiently.
Ah...it's the young lady who walked away very quickly last time. She still looks so energetic.
"Okay! I'll think of a way... No, I won't go to the restaurant today, that's it, bye." Yin Ce put the phone aside, propped his chin, and listened boredly to the conversation between the man and the woman - it seemed that this young lady had a lot of troubles.
"Lin Yanqiang, my friend Luo Manman has rejected you, what else do you want?" When Luo Manman couldn't be found, he came to her place of work to block her. Did he think she was easy to bully?
"I want her to tell me face to face!" Lin Yanqiang said angrily.
"Didn't I make it very clear last Tuesday? She rejected you 'in person'." If he had known it, he would have videotaped it as evidence, leaving him speechless.
"That's a matter between me and her, you don't have to worry about it."
"Her business is my business, please don't pester her anymore." Yan Taiyu put his hands on his hips, looking like a dominatrix.
"Did you ask her to reject me?" His conditions were so good, so I didn't understand why Roman Man rejected him at all. It must have been this woman's instigation!
"Mr. Sausage, if Miss Luo is interested in you, no matter what I say, it will be useless. Just face the reality, okay? The reality is that Miss Luo has very strange eyesight. She likes voluptuous men!" She didn't mean to deliberately undermine her friend, but she really had enough.
sausage? Yin Ce couldn't help but chuckle--this lady is really interesting.
Lin Yanqiang said angrily: "You woman, don't give me random nicknames. It's obvious that you are the one causing trouble and hindering me and Xiaoman!"
"Anyway, you won't listen to anything I say. I'm too lazy to talk to you." She ignored him and turned around to go around him. When she saw that he was blocking her way again, she pursed her lips and glared at him.
"You ask Xiaoman to come and talk to me."
"Why should I listen to you?"
"You──" Lin Yanqiang grabbed her wrist, "Take me to Xiaoman now!"
"Let go!" Yan Daiyu frowned. Just as she was in a stalemate with him, someone suddenly reached out and took Lin Yanqiang's hand. She looked up and immediately recognized the unlucky guy she had mistakenly identified the day before yesterday.
"Be gentle to the lady, and speak up if you have anything to say." Yin Ce advised in a good voice.
"Stop meddling in other people's business." Lin Yanqiang said in a bad tone.
Yan Daiyu smiled awkwardly at Yin Ce, "I can handle this myself."
She was already very sorry for this unlucky guy, so how could she still have the nerve to ask him to help drive away the plague god? She looked at Lin Yanqiang seriously, "Mr. Lin Yanqiang, Romanman is not suitable for you. Unless you gain thirty kilograms more, don't force it anymore." She said very honestly.
"You still want to lie to me!" If you ask him to gain another thirty kilograms, it would be strange if he would take it seriously.
She rubbed her brows in distress, "Otherwise, it would be better if I dated you instead."Okay, actually I have had a crush on you for a long time, and no matter how you look at me, you are more suitable. "She promised that within a day, he would cry and beg her to break up.
Yin Ce raised his eyebrows at her. She didn't look like she liked this man named Sausage at all.
“Who wants to date an ugly woman like you? Lin Yanqiang blushed.
"Ugly? "Yes! She is not as beautiful as Roman Man, but does he need to use the word "ugly"? But she still held back her anger, "Don't look at me like this, I have a very kind heart, otherwise you ask the nice gentleman next to me. "
Mr. Nice Guy? ! Yin Ce raised his eyebrows, feeling ridiculous in his heart.
"If you don't leave, I will think that you are actually secretly in love with me and want to date me. "After she finished speaking, she climbed onto Lin Yanqiang's arm.
Lin Yanqiang hurriedly backed away, "You crazy person, who would want to date a woman like you! "After that, he left angrily.
Yan Daiyu breathed a sigh of relief - the trouble was finally gone; she looked at the man beside her and grinned, "Thank you just now. "
"You're welcome. " He didn't want to pay attention, but he couldn't help but watch a man bullying a woman, "Is the Roman Man you just mentioned the one I met before? "
"right. "
"You really take care of your friends. "He remembered that the last time she made trouble for him, it was also to vent her anger on that young lady.
"Romanman is very stupid and can't do anything without taking care of things. "Lin Yanqiang has a good family background and has a good appearance, but he has the personality of a young master, and Luo Manman also has a personality that needs someone to take care of him, so the two are not suitable at all.
“She’s lucky to have you as a friend. "In his opinion, this woman is living too leisurely and is looking for trouble.
She kept a polite smile, but she was thinking in her heart - this man looked elegant and polite, and he was polite and courteous. If he and Luo Manman were together, they would be a match made in heaven.
The so-called way to cure a broken love is to have a new relationship. Maybe she can try it. "Thank you for your help, I'll buy you a drink. "
"You are welcome. "Does she want to strike up a conversation? It turns out it's another woman who's attracted to his appearance!
"It should. Besides, she hated owing people favors, "What do you want to drink?" Is oolong tea good? "
"good. "He followed her into the store and sat back down in his original seat, wanting to see what her plans were. "You work in this teahouse? "Seeing that she said hello to the waiter inside, she looked like a very familiar friend.
"Yes. She automatically sat across from him, "Let me introduce myself first. I am Yan Taiyu." He took out his name tag and let him take a look, "Just call me Big Fish. A fish is a fish that swims in the water." "
“I am Yin Ce. He looked at her and asked, "Won't your boss get angry if you chat with me like this?" "
"I've already gotten off work, I'm on the morning shift today. She glanced at him and said, "Can you tell me your occupation?" "She had to do a basic family investigation first and identify it for Luo Manman.
“I work in a restaurant. "
“So you’re also a waiter? ” She guessed about his job content.
“Don’t you think being a waiter is bad? "
"How come, it's not like we're not involved in production. "She thought he had admitted it--well~~it's good to have a legitimate job. She touched her nose and said, "Mr. Yin, you..."
“Speak up if you have something to say. " He smiled lightly, but he was thinking about how to teach her a lesson so that he could vent his resentment from the day before yesterday.
"Do you have a girlfriend? She was afraid of scaring people away, so she hurriedly added, "I'm not chasing you, you can rest assured. I just think you have a good personality and want to introduce friends to you." "
"Is that the lady named Luo Manman? "He was a little surprised. It turned out that she was asking for a friend.
"Yes, yes, that's her! You have also seen the petite and cute person who was hiding behind me last time. She has a good personality, is gentle and patient. ""It's good to make friends, but will she?" He began to think of excuses.
"Of course she would."
"Aren't you afraid that I'm a bad person?" He elegantly drank the tea that was just served to him. It was fragrant and sweet and not bad.
"Of course I can't leave her alone." She put her face on her hands and smiled with her eyes wide, "Let's have a meal together some other time!"
Yin Ce looked at her smiling face and wanted to refuse but suddenly remembered that the store was in urgent need of work-study students. He immediately changed his mind and said with a charming smile, "Okay!"
